name: Particles of Reality: Remembrance
source: Congrats! You've landed a dream job as a paranormal scientist with the government! Downside? Outside contact is limited and monitored. You learn it is 'who' (not 'what') you are researching, and... you're the reason these supernatural beings are here? Ignore the lurking Guardians of Reality...
translation: 恭喜！你已经在政府找到了一份梦想的工作，成为一名超自然科学家！缺点？外部接触受到限制和监控。你知道你正在研究的是“谁”（而不是“什么”），而且……你就是这些超自然生物出现在这里的原因？忽略潜伏的现实守护者……
